comparison.objective: Pull cable to a 30 cm mark without overpull or kinking; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable feed, handover, and visual length control versus hex-key alignment, fine rotary adjustment, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cable ends within 1 cm of target, remains straight, and never passes 35 cm; no dynamic stopping test.
comparison.reason: Both use iterative visual feedback, but cable length metering and damper-response commissioning are physically distinct.
